name: Rodentia
blurb: The largest order of mammals: squirrels, capybaras, mice and rats, with ever-growing incisors.

fossilMin.formation: Fort Union Formation, Eagle Mine, Carbon County, Montana, USA
fossilMin.dating: Clarkforkian index taxon, late Paleocene (Thanetian); top of the Thanetian, 56.0 Ma
fossilMin.checked: Benton et al. 2015, full text (palaeo-electronica.org/content/pdfs/424.pdf), node 77 (Crown Rodentia)

softMax.basis: Stem rodents and other Glires (Heomys, Mimotona) but no crown rodents: base of the Paleocene, 66.04 ± 0.4 Ma
softMax.checked: Benton et al. 2015, full text (palaeo-electronica.org/content/pdfs/424.pdf), node 77 (Crown Rodentia)

clock.method: Bayesian relaxed molecular clock (MCMCTree), posterior mean and 95% HPD
